sources.title: Structured Java interview source containing the odd/even alternating-print question
Deterministic and randomized two-thread ordering validation

claims.text: The preserved structured/tagged source asks only for two threads alternating odd/even numbers; it does not define the range, starting parity, synchronization primitive, or interruption policy.
The candidate makes 0..maxInclusive and even-first behavior an explicit executable contract rather than presenting them as source facts, and explains the one-line adaptation for a 1-based contract.

The monitor-based implementation terminates and emits exactly 0..maxInclusive under deterministic and 1000 seeded randomized cases, including both thread start orders and the maxInclusive=0 edge case.
Validation confirms both threads terminate after the final state transition, exercising the candidate's explicit end-of-range notification path.
